keyPoints: Sanyukt thos (combination of solids) me do aakaar judte hain — shanku par belan, belan par ardh-gola, jaise jhanda ya ice-cream — neeche belan, upar shanku ya gola.
Kul prishthiya me sirf dikhai dene wali satah jodo — judne wali andaruni satah mat gino, wo chhup jaati hai.
Kul aaytan = dono thoson ke aaytanon ka yog — andar ka hissa ghatana nahi padta, dono poore judte hain.
Chhinnak (frustum): shanku ko aadhar ke samantar kaatne par bachta hissa — balti aur topi isi aakaar ki hoti hain.
Chhinnak ka aaytan = (1/3)πh(r1² + r2² + r1r2); vakr prishthiya = πl(r1 + r2) — dono trijyaon ka dhyan rakho.
Ek thos ko pighla kar doosra banane par aaytan same rehta hai — gend se sikke banana, mombatti pighlana isi par hai.
Aam galti: sanyukt aakaar me chhupe hisse ka kshetrafal bhi jod dena — jo dikhta nahi, wo gina nahi jaata.
